latest.title: Fix: warehouses fed by your own factory no longer read as short
latest.summary: A warehouse your own factory tops up every morning on a logistics route was flagged as a critical import shortfall for every item the factory delivers, often with an alert that weekly orders cannot cover their week and a large one-off to bring in. The board now counts what your factories bring on routes before it judges the import, so a backup import next to such a route no longer raises the alarm, paused or not. If a route brings only part of what leaves, the import is sized on the rest, and a busy day that could still empty the shelf before the next morning's round is still flagged. The Factories page takes the same routes into account.
